about: Briefs: one guided form per kind of creative job. Code turns the answers into one build-ready brief (no AI, no credits), with a check-your-work list the AI runs before it shows anything. The lessons come from the 127 hero rounds on Oct 20 and the reel recipes (v2/research/reels-oct20). Each chip's `says` is the designer wording it adds to the brief.

shared.opening: You are a senior creative developer and motion designer. Build this right the first time from the brief below. Where an answer is missing, use the default written next to it and keep going. Ask me a question only if something is marked [ASK].
rules: Use only the words I give you. Where words are missing, write [PLACEHOLDER]. Never make up numbers, reviews, client logos, awards or results.
One idea per section. Motion follows the person (load, scroll, pointer); nothing loops forever except slow ambient movement.
Easing: expo.out for things arriving, power2.inOut for scroll scrubs. Nothing bounces or springs unless the brief asks for it.
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 for body and 3:1 for big headlines. Dim text uses a muted color, never low opacity.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion: show each animation's final frame, still.
Works with JavaScript off and with reduced motion: a complete, still page. A Pause motion button stops every loop.

Speed: the first screen paints from a still poster at full opacity (no fade on the biggest image). Load 3D and video after the page loads and goes idle. Cap devicePixelRatio at 2. Pause anything offscreen or in a hidden tab. Preload only the font weights the first screen uses. Aim for Lighthouse mobile 90 or above.
Phones and computers without a real graphics chip get the still poster or a short muted loop, not the live 3D.
Bundle every library and font with the site. Nothing loads from a CDN or another company's server.
review: Before you show me anything, check your own work:
1. Take screenshots at 390px and 1440px wide: top, middle and end of the page.
2. For anything that moves, grab frames at 0s, 0.5s, 1s and 2s of the intro, and one mid-scroll.
3. Go down the checklist below. Mark each line pass or fail, in one line each.
4. Fix every fail, then check again once.
5. Then send me: the files, the screenshots, the marked checklist and at most one question. No recap of the brief.
shared.revisions: When I ask for changes later, change only what I list, keep everything else exactly as it is, and send back only the files that changed with one line per change.
premium: Nothing staged: no decorative glow, floor line, spotlight, blurred blobs or showcase props. Light and shadow come from the subject.
It arrives, it doesn't appear: the first 1.2 to 2.4s is one intro where the thing forms, assembles or unfolds, then the page is usable. Never a fade-up of everything at once.
It's alive at rest: something keeps moving with physics (drifts, breathes, leans toward the pointer, reacts to a tap), small and slow, never competing with reading.
One scroll moment: one section where scroll drives the story (scrubbed, pinned or a scene change), and scrolling back runs it backwards.
Real type and hierarchy: one display face big and tight, one quiet body face, generous space, one accent. Buttons, forms and nav as considered as the hero.

avoid.label: Staged glow or backdrop light
avoid.says: No glow, spotlight or halo behind the subject. Light comes from the subject itself or the scene, never a backdrop.

avoid.label: Floor lines or fake reflections
avoid.says: No horizon line, floor line or mirrored reflection under the subject.

avoid.label: Feels like a still picture
avoid.says: It must not feel like a still image being nudged around. It is truly animated: it forms, moves and reacts in real time.

avoid.label: Bouncy or springy motion
avoid.says: No bounce, overshoot or springy easing.

avoid.label: Faded, low-contrast text
avoid.says: No text faded by opacity. Dim text uses a muted color that still passes contrast.

avoid.label: Made-up numbers, reviews or logos
avoid.says: No invented stats, testimonials, ratings, client logos or results.

avoid.label: Stock photos of people
avoid.says: No stock photos of people. Use abstract placeholders in the palette until real photos arrive.

avoid.label: Gradient text everywhere
avoid.says: Gradient text on one headline at most.

avoid.label: Too many effects at once
avoid.says: One effect per section. If two things move at once, cut one.

avoid.label: Sound that plays by itself
avoid.says: No sound until the person turns it on.

feel.label: Too static
feel.says: Make it come alive: the intro shows the thing forming (not a fade-in), then slow ambient motion, and it reacts to pointer, tap and scroll in real time.

feel.label: Feels staged
feel.says: Remove backdrop glows, floor lines and spotlights. Light comes from the subject. Fewer props, more space.

feel.label: Feels cheap
feel.says: Cut to one accent color, add more empty space, slow the easing (expo.out, 0.8s to 1.2s), sharpen the type scale (one big size, one small), remove drop shadows and borders.

feel.label: Too busy
feel.says: One idea per section. Remove the weakest effect in each section and half the decorative elements.

feel.label: Too plain
feel.says: Add one signature moment: a real intro on load and one scroll moment where something transforms. Keep everything else quiet.

feel.label: Too dark
feel.says: Lift the darkest areas so shapes read, keep the background near-black, and light the subject from within.

feel.label: Too slow
feel.says: Intro under 1.2s on a website (under 2.5s in a video), and the headline readable within 1s.

feel.label: Too fast
feel.says: Give each move room: 0.8s to 1.2s, with the next starting as the last settles.

feel.label: Wrong mood
feel.says: Re-read the mood words and references in the brief. Match their light, pace and type before anything else.

alive.label: Drifts slowly
alive.says: After the intro it keeps a slow ambient drift (sway, float or light shifting), 6 to 10 seconds per cycle.

alive.label: Follows the cursor
alive.says: It turns or leans toward the pointer, softly, with lag (lerp about 0.08 per frame).

alive.label: Reacts to tap or click
alive.says: A tap or click gives a small physical reaction (ripple, wobble or pulse) that settles in under 1s.

alive.label: Changes on scroll
alive.says: Scroll drives it: it transforms as the page scrolls and reverses when scrolling back up.

alive.label: Settles still
alive.says: After the intro it settles and holds still.

pace.label: Calm
pace.says: Calm pace: moves 0.9s to 1.4s, long holds.

pace.label: Fast
pace.says: Fast pace: moves 0.3s to 0.6s, quick cuts.

look.label: Light and glow
look.says: Light is the only decoration: a slow shader gradient field on near-black that drifts and leans toward the cursor, lighting headlines from behind. Glass pills for cards.

look.label: Editorial
look.says: Editorial motion study: giant kinetic type, photos revealed through shapes and masks, one bold accent on a plain ground. CSS and GSAP only, no WebGL.

look.label: Cinematic 3D scroll
look.says: Cinematic 3D scroll story: a Three.js scene where scroll moves the camera along a path through named chapters, type pinned over it.

look.label: Curved 3D gallery
look.says: Curved gallery: cards on the inside of a WebGL cylinder that turns with drag and scroll, bending slightly with speed.

look.label: Exploded product
look.says: Exploded product: scroll lifts the product apart into its layers with thin callout lines, then puts it back together.

look.label: Liquid
look.says: Liquid: shapes form out of moving liquid (metaballs or a raymarched surface) and melt back on scroll.

look.label: Clean and quiet
look.says: Clean and quiet: lots of space, one typeface, small precise motion, no 3D.

look.label: Kinetic type
look.says: Kinetic type: the words are the visual. Letters slide up from masks, track wider on entry and scrub with scroll.

look.label: Particle swarm
look.says: Particle swarm: thousands of points that gather into the subject and scatter on scroll.

look.label: Film grain and dither
look.says: Dither and film grain: a soft halftone or dithered texture over a restrained palette.

type.label: Clean grotesk
type.says: Type: a clean grotesk (like Geist or Inter Tight), tight tracking on headlines, 1.5 line height on body.

type.label: Editorial serif
type.says: Type: a high-contrast editorial serif for headlines, a quiet sans for body.

type.label: Wide display
type.says: Type: a wide display face for headlines at 12vw or more, a compact sans for body.

type.label: Mono accents
type.says: Add a mono face for small labels and numbers.

type.label: You pick
type.says: Pick the type to match the mood words. Self-host the fonts.

mobile.label: Phone gets a still
mobile.says: On phones under 768px, swap the live scene for a pre-rendered still of its best frame.

mobile.label: Phone gets a short loop
mobile.says: On phones under 768px, swap the live scene for a short muted loop (under 1 MB) with a still poster.

mobile.label: Same as desktop
mobile.says: Phones get the same live scene at reduced resolution (render at half size, upscale).

stack.label: Plain HTML and CSS
stack.says: Stack: plain HTML and CSS, a few lines of vanilla JS at most. No frameworks.

stack.label: HTML + GSAP
stack.says: Stack: HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with GSAP + ScrollTrigger for scroll and Lenis for smooth scroll. No UI kits.

stack.label: HTML + Motion
stack.says: Stack: HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with Motion (motion.dev) for the intro, alive and scroll moments. No UI kits.

stack.label: HTML + GSAP + Three.js
stack.says: Stack: vanilla JS, Three.js for 3D, GSAP + ScrollTrigger for scroll, Lenis for smooth scroll, GLSL for shaders. No UI kits.

stack.label: React + React Three Fiber
stack.says: Stack: React with React Three Fiber and drei for 3D, GSAP + ScrollTrigger, Lenis. No UI kits.

stack.label: You pick
stack.says: Stack: the lightest one that does the job. Prefer HTML, CSS and GSAP; add Three.js only for real 3D.

assets.label: My logo
assets.says: Use my logo file (I'll attach it). Keep its shape exact.

assets.label: My photos
assets.says: Use my photos (I'll attach them). Crop, never stretch.

assets.label: My video
assets.says: Use my video clips (I'll attach them), muted, with a still poster.

assets.label: A 3D model
assets.says: Use my 3D model (GLB, I'll attach it).

assets.label: Nothing yet
assets.says: I have no assets yet. Use clean placeholders in the palette, built from simple geometry, and list every file to swap in with its size.

frame.label: Centered, facing forward
frame.says: Framing: the subject is centered and faces straight at the viewer.

frame.label: Off center
frame.says: Framing: the subject sits off center (about a third in), with the words in the open side.

frame.label: Close-up
frame.says: Framing: a close-up that fills most of the frame.

frame.label: Wide
frame.says: Framing: wide, the subject small in a big space.

material.label: Glass
material.says: Material: clear glass that bends what's behind it, lit from within.

material.label: Liquid
material.says: Material: liquid that stays liquid, with surface tension, drips and ripples.

material.label: Brushed metal
material.says: Material: brushed metal with soft studio reflections.

material.label: Light only
material.says: Material: made of light alone, no solid surface.

material.label: Matte
material.says: Material: soft matte surface, like clay or paper.

output.label: Live on a web page
output.says: Output: runs live in the browser in real time (WebGL or canvas), with a still poster that paints first.

output.label: Still image
output.says: Output: a still image at 2x size, PNG.

intro_style.label: Develops like a photo
intro_style.says: Intro style: the subject develops like a photograph (soft and grey to sharp and full color) while the words come into focus one by one.

intro_style.label: Assembles
intro_style.says: Intro style: the headline letters fly in from scattered places and lock together; the subject lands into place.

intro_style.label: Pours in
intro_style.says: Intro style: the letters drop in left to right like something poured; the subject fills from the bottom up.

intro_style.label: Unfolds
intro_style.says: Intro style: the words unfold upward from their baseline like a turned page; the subject opens from its center.

intro_style.label: Types out
intro_style.says: Intro style: the headline types out letter by letter with a caret; the subject wipes on from the left.

intro_style.label: No intro
intro_style.says: Intro style: no intro, the first screen is there at once.

scroll_style.label: Moves with the scroll
scroll_style.says: Scroll moment style: the section's pieces move with the scroll, in order, and back when scrolling up.

scroll_style.label: Holds and steps through
scroll_style.says: Scroll moment style: the section holds on screen while its pieces step through one by one (on phones it doesn't hold; the pieces light as they pass).

scroll_style.label: Changes scene
scroll_style.says: Scroll moment style: the section changes scene as it crosses the screen, its pieces moving at their own depth.

scroll_style.label: Draws your steps
scroll_style.says: Scroll moment style: your steps or services draw as a line of points that lights up with the scroll and ends at your button.

kinds.title: Website
kinds.when: A premium one-page site or landing page that looks right on the first try.
kinds.heading: WEBSITE BRIEF

fields.label: Business name
fields.example: Northside Detailing

fields.label: What you do
fields.example: Mobile car detailing in Austin

fields.label: Who it's for
fields.example: Busy parents with SUVs who want the car back to new

fields.label: The one thing a visitor should do
fields.example: Book a detail

fields.label: Your words (headline, services, prices, about)
fields.example: Paste what you have. Gaps become [PLACEHOLDER].

fields.label: Mood in three words
fields.example: quiet, precise, expensive

fields.label: 2 or 3 references (sites, brands, films)
fields.example: apple.com/airpods-pro, Aesop, the opening of Blade Runner 2049

fields.label: Colors (hex), one accent
fields.example: #060607, #E3E6F1, accent #D8B46E
fields.default: near-black, off-white and one accent from the mood

fields.label: What happens when the page opens
fields.example: The logo starts as loose water in a dark pond and forms as it rises, then floats
fields.lead: Intro, 1.2 to 2.4s, from this start to this end

fields.label: The scroll moment
fields.example: As you scroll past the hero, the logo melts back into the pond

fields.label: Sections, top to bottom, one per line
fields.example:
Hero
What you get
How it works
Prices
Book
fields.default: Hero, what you get, how it works, proof (only real quotes), call to action

fields.label: Anything else to avoid
fields.example: No purple. No 'Welcome to our website'.

checks: The first screen says what {business} does and for whom within 3 seconds.
The one button reads "{action}" and is visible on the first screen at 390px.
Every word on the page is mine or marked [PLACEHOLDER].

kinds.title: Hero or animation
kinds.when: One signature moment: a logo that forms, a hero that comes alive, a product reveal.
kinds.heading: HERO / ANIMATION BRIEF

fields.label: What's the star
fields.example: Our 127 logo

fields.label: Where it lives
fields.example: Homepage hero, above the headline

fields.label: Background
fields.example: Near-black, a still dark pond

fields.label: It starts as
fields.example: Loose, unformed water under a dark surface

fields.label: It ends as
fields.example: The 127, fully formed in clear glass, floating

fields.label: How it gets from start to end
fields.example: The pond swells, liquid climbs out still joined to the water, pulls itself into the shape and breaks free, dripping

fields.label: On scroll or exit
fields.example: Melts back into the pond as you scroll, re-forms when you scroll back up

fields.label: Light
fields.example: Lit from within; the only light in the scene
fields.default: light comes from the subject; no backdrop light

fields.label: Mood in three words
fields.example: alive, calm, expensive

fields.label: References
fields.example: Apple Vision Pro reveal, liquid metal in Terminator 2

fields.label: Anything else to avoid
fields.example: Don't just fade the logo in. Don't rotate it more than 15 degrees.

checks: Frame 0s shows: {start}. The last intro frame shows: {end}.
The middle frames show it forming, not fading or sliding in whole.
{subject} keeps its exact shape once formed.
The still poster matches the final frame, so there is no jump when the live version takes over.

kinds.title: Ad, video or image
kinds.when: A short ad, reel or graphic that comes out on brand the first time (for Studio or your own AI).
kinds.heading: AD / VIDEO BRIEF

fields.label: What you're showing
fields.example: Our $49 interior detail

fields.label: Who it's for
fields.example: Parents with a messy SUV

fields.label: The first 2 seconds
fields.example: A crumb-covered back seat, then one swipe and it's clean

fields.label: Exact words on screen and in the voice-over
fields.example: Paste them. Nothing else gets added.

fields.label: The ask at the end
fields.example: Book on our site

fields.label: Mood in three words
fields.example: clean, satisfying, quick

fields.label: Music and sound
fields.example: No music, just the vacuum and a soft whoosh
fields.default: light music bed, words on screen work with sound off

fields.label: Brand colors and fonts
fields.example: #0B0B0C, #F4F3EF, Geist

fields.label: Anything else to avoid
fields.example: No fake countdown. No before-and-after we didn't shoot.

checks: Every word on screen is from my list, spelled the same.
The words read with the sound off.
The last frame shows "{action}" for at least 1.5 seconds.
Nothing promises results, income or a deadline I didn't give.
Text stays inside the safe area for each format.

kinds.title: Ask for changes
kinds.when: One round of changes, all at once, so the next version is the one.
kinds.heading: CHANGE LIST

fields.label: What you're looking at
fields.example: The homepage hero, version 3

fields.label: Keep exactly as it is
fields.example: The colors, the headline, the way it floats

fields.label: One per line: where | what's wrong | what you want instead
fields.example:
Hero | the logo just appears | it should start as water and form as it rises
Under the logo | there's a line | remove it

checks: Everything under KEEP looks the same as before.
Each change above is done (one line each).
kinds.opening: You made the thing below. Here is one complete round of changes, all at once. Do every change on the list, keep what's under KEEP exactly as it is, and don't redesign anything I didn't mention.
